definitions.explanation: a cooking vessel used to cook food with steam

examples.english: To steam vegetables in a steamer.

examples.japanese: {蒸|む}し{器|き}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}し→茶碗蒸し：17312_chawanmushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made chawanmushi in a steamer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{蒸|む}し{器|き}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧だ。
examples.english: Electric steamers make temperature control easy.

TYPES:
- ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蒸|む}し{器|き} - bamboo steamer (Chinese/Asian style)
